user.title: Home Dashboard
user.description: Adds the Home Dashboard dashboard strategy. After this step create a new dashboard and set its strategy to `custom:home-dashboard`.

init.title: Settings
init.description: Apply to every dashboard and device, at once.

data.editor_in_sidebar: Show the editor in the sidebar
data.activity_in_sidebar: Show Household activity in the sidebar

data_description.editor_in_sidebar: The Dashboard editor panel (administrators only). Hidden, it still opens at /home-dashboard-editor.
data_description.activity_in_sidebar: The Household activity panel (administrators; its data only for the owner). Hidden, it still opens at /home-dashboard-activity.
data_description.activity_record: The dashboards write down the pages and windows each person opens, kept 30 days for the Household activity panel. Off: nothing new is written; what was written goes away after 30 days.

show_camera.name: Show a camera
show_camera.description: Opens the dashboard's own window of a camera on the open dashboards asked for, with the picture of the event. It closes by itself after a while unless somebody turns on the live view; the event home_dashboard_camera_closed says when it is gone.

entity_id.name: Camera
entity_id.description: The camera (camera.*) or its picture (image.*) as the dashboard shows it.

picture.name: Picture of the event
picture.description: An image.* entity with the snapshot of the event, shown until the live view starts. Empty: the camera's own picture.

title.name: Title
title.description: The title of the window. Empty: the name of the camera.

close_after.name: Close after
close_after.description: Seconds before the window closes by itself; 0 keeps it open; counted while the screen shows it. The live view or a touch keeps it open.

live_limit.name: Live view at most
live_limit.description: Seconds the window stays open at most once the live view is on.

live.name: Live view at once
live.description: Starts the live view as the window opens (a camera that records all the time); it still closes after the time above unless somebody touches it.

interrupt.name: Comes first
interrupt.description: Replaces the window of another camera on the screen (e.g. the doorbell over a motion window); the settings and editing are still never taken away.

browser_id.name: Devices
browser_id.description: Browser Mod ids of the devices to open it on (e.g. hall_ipad). Empty: every device.

user_id.name: People
user_id.description: Home Assistant user ids to open it for. Empty: everybody.
